description: Reference results for BrainCog-14 brain-LLM representational similarity.
metric: Spearman rho on 91 upper-triangle pairs of 14x14 RDM (brain vs model)

permutation_null.note: rho > 0.25 exceeds the 95th percentile of the null distribution

noise_ceiling.method: split-half correlation of LLM RDM (50 random splits)

scaling.note: Qwen2.5 family, all Instruct variants, same pipeline

GloVe-300d.note: Static word embeddings (mean-pooled per stimulus). Captures lexical co-occurrence structure.

condition_name_GloVe.note: GloVe embedding of the condition label string alone. Measures label leakage.

sentence_length.note: RDM from mean sentence lengths per condition. Surface confound.

partial_RSA_all_confounds_removed.note: LLM rho after partialling out GloVe, condition name, and length confounds. ~80% retained.

interpretation.below_0.25: Not distinguishable from chance (below null 95th percentile)
interpretation.0.25_to_0.50: Above chance; comparable to static-embedding baselines
interpretation.above_0.70: Near noise ceiling; comparable to reference LLMs
